description: Unit tests for SerialWorker class in net/dns, testing serial execution, retries, cancellation, and backoff behavior.

classes.name: SerialWorkerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing SerialWorker behavior, including serial execution, retries, cancellation, and backoff.

classes.name: SerialWorkerTest::TestSerialWorker
classes.description: Mock implementation of SerialWorker used for testing.

classes.name: SerialWorkerTest::TestWorkItem
classes.description: Work item class used in tests to simulate work and follow-up actions.

methods.name: OnWork
methods.description: Simulates work execution, checks serial execution, updates output, and signals completion.

methods.name: OnFollowup
methods.description: Handles follow-up work, possibly triggers immediate follow-up completion.

methods.name: OnWorkFinished
methods.description: Checks if work succeeded, updates counters, and signals completion.

methods.name: BreakCallback
methods.description: Sets a breakpoint string and quits the run loop.

methods.name: BreakNow
methods.description: Posts a task to trigger BreakCallback with a given string.

methods.name: RunUntilBreak
methods.description: Runs the event loop until a specified breakpoint string is encountered.

methods.name: CompleteFollowup
methods.description: Posts the follow-up closure to the task runner.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and task runner.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, cancels worker, and ensures no stalled work.

methods.name: UnblockWork
methods.description: Signals to allow work to proceed and waits for completion.
